existingBoundaries: GET /api/v1/network/dispatcher/controller/chat and /sessions remain desktop-only under current pinned desktop membership and host agent.read.
Generic mobile agent endpoints and commands continue rejecting hidden controller ids; do not modify activeDispatcher or findMobileAgent to expose them.

Phone paired-human admission is not an agent MCP grant. Proposed new role-specific adapter uses current direct pinned phone control/read authority and current host privacy; it must not manufacture an agent caller or bypass Off/Ask policies applicable to that authority.

advertisedCapabilities.location: GET /api/v1/mobile/capabilities, under dispatcher; proposed names require #3720 owner overlap confirmation
advertisedCapabilities.availability: Omit when not authorized/unsupported. Off or missing Dispatcher cannot be created or woken by reads. Go sends nothing without the corresponding advertised version; no guessed URL, desktop-route probe or old-command fallback.

readAuthorization.transport: Direct host pinned mTLS, current paired phone identified by existing controllerSurface; persistent and valid session-only pairings retain their current direct-phone semantics.
readAuthorization.predicate: Current Annex principal still authorized for this host and controlling role, paired phone surface, Dispatcher enabled/current and existing phone read/privacy policy allows it. Independent review must confirm this paired-human policy distinction before code; no desktop agent.read identity is synthesized.
readAuthorization.recheck: Capture immutable pairing/pin/role, host-selected work-controller identity and session ownership; recheck after awaited reads and immediately before publication. Revocation/pin/role/host-policy changes withhold response; no cached content is published.
readAuthorization.target: Host resolves its own controller only. Accept no agent id, caller id, machine, path, project, native session id or cross-host target.
readAuthorization.headers: Cache-Control: no-store; no transcript/path/token contents in logs.

readQuery.constraints: Exactly one value per key; unknown/duplicate keys reject400. beforeSeq>=1, afterSeq>=0, exclusive; integer limit1..2000/default500. sessionId opaque, nonempty<=256 and bound to selected host controller's transcript store.

readProjection.eventAllowlist: Versioned plain user/agent text plus allowlisted fixed recovery notices. Apply existing phone Dispatcher privacy/noise rules; no thoughts, tool calls/arguments/output, plans, subagents, actionable permissions/questions, raw routed instructions, grant receipts or control fields.
readProjection.redaction: Fold streamed text before existing known-secret-pattern/secret-field redaction. This is best-effort redaction, not a claim arbitrary secret text is detectable.
readProjection.identity: No physical controller agent id, native provider session id, local path/root, provider config, command token, attachment bytes or fetch capability in the read DTO.
readProjection.cursor: Scan a bounded source-sequence window first, then filter/project. Cursors advance using scanned source sequence even if every event is filtered; filtering must not cause gaps or an endless empty page.
readProjection.bound: Reuse current encoded 8MiB mobile page ceiling; accept exactly the bound and refuse oversized indivisible projected text explicitly rather than silently truncate. Existing bounded principal rate policy, no polling/retry/deadline expansion.
readProjection.sessions: Version1/readOnly role-specific index. Only selected controller's opaque session ids and sanitized timestamps/count/title metadata; no provider/native ids or filesystem paths; same authority and encoded bound.

refusals.401_403: Existing TLS/pairing/role/policy refusals; no private body on revoked or denied reads.
refusals.404_405: Unsupported route/version; Go does not probe or fall back.
refusals.409: Dispatcher off/unavailable or target/session ownership changed; no automatic wake or recovery.
refusals.413: Projected event or session index exceeds encoded bound.
refusals.429: Existing bounded rate refusal with Retry-After.
refusals.500: Sanitized bounded read error; no filesystem/transcript details.

recoverySettings.tokenBinding: Phone principal, app/mobile epoch, action+reset choice, Dispatcher switch generation, work-controller identity/session/recovery generation, and visible chat identity/session/clear generation where applicable. Separate choices never share a token. Tokens stale on replacement, restart, another recovery/clear or role/pin revocation.

recoverySemantics.default: Absent resetChat means false. Recover work only via existing startDispatcherFresh('work'); visible chat/session and retained transcript history are preserved. A damaged work native session may be quarantined/replaced, not deleted from transcript history.
recoverySemantics.explicitReset: Only resetChat:true plus its matching explicit confirmation invokes existing 'both' scope. Existing dispatcher.clearChat remains a distinct confirmed Start new chat action, never a recovery fallback.
recoverySemantics.effects: Stop/cancel only requests owned by replaced controller turn/queue; delegated agent work continues. Memory, agents, connections, Actions and settings stay unchanged. Sleeping recovery applies next wake. Return actual work now/next_start and chat preserved/now/next_start.
recoverySemantics.authorization: Revalidate authority and action-bound precondition after awaited preparation, immediately before irreversible effects. Single-winner recovery/clear generation prevents two confirmations on one state. Partial/failing effects are reported honestly, never false success.
recoverySemantics.delivery: Reuse existing mobile commandId/epoch receipts. Cancel-before-send sends nothing; uncertain replies are not automatically replayed. Do not add recovery retry, background reset or client-off wake policy.
recoverySemantics.q5: Retain current waiting-request capture/settlement boundaries and existing notice hooks. Durable notice ledger and chat-runtime/group-project settlement stay solely with Q5 owner; no parallel store, ledger, replay policy or settlement rewrite.
